content.title: How to watch Grizzlies vs. Nuggets: TV channel and streaming options for April 8
content.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (25-54) will try to end a five-game losing streak when they hit the road to play the Denver Nuggets (51-28) on April 8, 2026 at Ball Arena.How to watch Memphis Grizzlies vs. Denver Nuggets Venue: Ball Arena Time: 9 p.m. ET TV: ALT, KTVD, KUSA, FDSSE Streaming (in-market viewers): Fubo (try for free) Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Memphis vs. Denver odds Spread: Denver -23.5 (-102), Memphis +23.5 (-118) Favorite Moneyline: Denver -10000 Underdog Moneyline: Memphis +1900 Total: 246.5 Total Over Odds: -110 Total Under Odds: -110 Odds provided by BetMGM.Injury reportsNuggetsSpencer Jones: Out (Hamstring), Peyton Watson: Out (Hamstring)GrizzliesOlivier-Maxence Prosper: Day-To-Day (Ankle), Gregory Jackson II: Out (Knee), Ty Jerome: Out (Ankle), Cam Spencer: Out (Back), Jahmai Mashack: Questionable (Concussion), Javon Small: Out (Thigh), Scotty Pippen Jr.: Out For Season (Toe), Santi Aldama: Out For Season (Knee), Kentavious Caldwell-Pope: Out For Season (Finger), Zach Edey: Out For Season (Ankle), Brandon Clarke: Out For Season (Calf), Jaylen Wells: Out For Season (Toe), Ja Morant: Out For Season (Elbow)Stats to know The Nuggets score 121.8 points per game (only 1.8 more points than the 120.0 the Grizzlies allow). The Grizzlies’ 115.0 points per game are just 2.0 fewer points than the 117.0 the Nuggets surrender to opponents.
